propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md contain stale prose claiming --force is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP for transition and claim operations, contradicting the shipped MCP implementation.
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling allows --force on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) with audit via absent signed attestation rather than capability withholding.
The MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py were already corrected by the scratchy-leprous-galago commit, but canonical documentation prose still asserts the old CLI-only policy.
The fix requires rewriting the transition/claim --force paragraphs in AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md to document force-everywhere, absent-attestation audit, and CI-certification enforcement.
Out-of-scope CLI-only families (--allow-secret-pattern, bridge setup wizard) must remain unchanged.
